data.title: 伽玛 · 金库盘点的解扣时刻
data.description: 地下金库闷热，伽玛解开职业套装的衬衫纽扣透气，长发垂落在成排的金币箱之间。她逐箱核对封条，指尖划过冰凉的金币——整个庭园的财富，在她手里从来分毫不差。
data.action: 坐在金币箱上核对封条，衬衫解扣，长发垂落
data.lighting: cold golden glow of magic-stone lamps in the vault
data.promptProse: In the Mitsugoshi Bank vault, adult Gamma sits on a crate of gold coins checking seals, her blouse unbuttoned against the heat, indigo hair spilling over the ledger.
data.animaCaption: Surrounded by the Garden's fortune, Gamma loosens her blouse and keeps counting — perfectly.
